title: 2024 AMC 10B Problem 23
statement:
The Fibonacci numbers are defined by \(F_1 = 1,\) \(F_2 = 1,\) and \(F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}\) for \(n \ge 3.\) What is

\[\frac{F_2}{F_1} + \frac{F_4}{F_2} + \frac{F_6}{F_3} + \cdots + \frac{F_{20}}{F_{10}}?\]

solutions.text: Use \(F_{2k} = F_k L_k,\) so each term \(\dfrac{F_{2k}}{F_k} = L_k,\) the \(k\)th Lucas number. That collapses the sum to \(\sum_{k=1}^{10} L_k.\) With \(L_1 = 1,\) \(L_2 = 3,\) \(L_3 = 4,\) \(\ldots,\) \(L_{10} = 123,\) the identity \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} L_k = L_{n+2} - 3\) gives \(L_{12} - 3 = 322 - 3 = 319.\) Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Each term is \(\dfrac{F_{2k}}{F_k};\) use the identity \(F_{2k} = F_k L_k,\) where \(L_k\) is the Lucas number
The sum becomes \(L_1 + L_2 + \cdots + L_{10};\) sums of Lucas numbers satisfy \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} L_k = L_{n+2} - 3\)
